description: This file provides utility functions for converting string representations into various protobuf types, including primitives, slices, timestamps, durations, enums, and wrapper types, primarily used in gRPC gateway runtime.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns the input string, mainly for compatibility.

methods.name: StringSlice
methods.description: Splits a string into a slice of strings based on a separator.

methods.name: Bool
methods.description: Parses a string into a boolean value.

methods.name: BoolSlice
methods.description: Splits a string and parses each element into a boolean slice.

methods.name: Float64
methods.description: Parses a string into a float64.

methods.name: Float64Slice
methods.description: Splits a string and parses each element into a float64 slice.

methods.name: Float32
methods.description: Parses a string into a float32.

methods.name: Float32Slice
methods.description: Splits a string and parses each element into a float32 slice.

methods.name: Int64
methods.description: Parses a string into an int64.

methods.name: Int64Slice
methods.description: Splits a string and parses each element into an int64 slice.

methods.name: Int32
methods.description: Parses a string into an int32.

methods.name: Int32Slice
methods.description: Splits a string and parses each element into an int32 slice.

methods.name: Uint64
methods.description: Parses a string into a uint64.

methods.name: Uint64Slice
methods.description: Splits a string and parses each element into a uint64 slice.

methods.name: Uint32
methods.description: Parses a string into a uint32.

methods.name: Uint32Slice
methods.description: Splits a string and parses each element into a uint32 slice.

methods.name: Bytes
methods.description: Decodes a URL-safe base64 string into bytes.

methods.name: BytesSlice
methods.description: Splits a string and decodes each part into a byte slice.

methods.name: Timestamp
methods.description: Converts an RFC3339 string into a protobuf Timestamp.

methods.name: Duration
methods.description: Converts a string into a protobuf Duration.

methods.name: Enum
methods.description: Converts a string into an enum int32, using a provided map.

methods.name: EnumSlice
methods.description: Splits a string and converts each part into an enum int32.

methods.name: StringValue
methods.description: Wraps a string in a protobuf StringValue.

methods.name: FloatValue
methods.description: Wraps a float32 in a protobuf FloatValue.

methods.name: DoubleValue
methods.description: Wraps a float64 in a protobuf DoubleValue.

methods.name: BoolValue
methods.description: Wraps a bool in a protobuf BoolValue.

methods.name: Int32Value
methods.description: Wraps an int32 in a protobuf Int32Value.

methods.name: UInt32Value
methods.description: Wraps a uint32 in a protobuf UInt32Value.

methods.name: Int64Value
methods.description: Wraps an int64 in a protobuf Int64Value.

methods.name: UInt64Value
methods.description: Wraps a uint64 in a protobuf UInt64Value.

methods.name: BytesValue
methods.description: Wraps bytes in a protobuf BytesValue.
